items.question: What can be moved on a flatbed?
items.answer: Machinery, steel and fabricated materials, construction materials and other cargo that suits open-deck loading.

items.question: What if my cargo is oversized or very heavy?
items.answer: For larger or more complex loads we plan the movement as project cargo. See our Heavy and Project Cargo page.

items.question: Do you secure the load?
items.answer: Yes. Load positioning and securing are planned for each cargo before dispatch.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Tell us the cargo, weight and dimensions, pickup point, destination and timeline, and our team will recommend a transportation approach.
